<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 7"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Master of Apprentice](/Feats.aspx?ID=4167) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="General" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=78" />
<trait label="Skill" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=144" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 73

</column>

---

Teaching is a difficult art form, but you've gotten a pretty good handle on it. When you [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=43) or [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23) during downtime, you can also attempt to [Aid](/Actions.aspx?ID=75) another creature doing the same with the same skill if they have a lower proficiency bonus than you. If you succeed, they can use the better result between your check and their own check.
